messages:
alex: Kicking off a config-only deploy: tenant throttles + request timeouts. Canary 8% -> 40% over 40m window. deploy-bot will post progress.
deploy-bot: deployctl: create rollout id=cfg-throttle-2026-03-21 canary=8% change_window=40m
sam: Quick summary of changes:
- tenant_min_tokens: 10
- per_tenant_rate_limit: 120r/min
- request_timeout_ms: 12_000
- routing_policy: balanced-cost
lee: adding: batching target reduced to 15ms to lower latency tail, max_batch_tokens=1024. Also enabling prefix cache warming for warm tenants.
ops-bot: Note: temporary alert rule set: cfg-throttle-95p spike > 1.1s for 10m -> notify #eng-oncall
tara: On-call here. I'll watch the usual latency, error-rate, and KV cache usage. If any of these hit (95p > 1100ms for 10m) or error-rate +25% we'll pause ramp.
alex: Rollout plan: 8% -> 20% after 12m, then to 40% after 28m if all good. Pin routing/model variants for canary to avoid confounding model changes.
sam: Pinned canary routing to model:v1.2-stable for the cohort.
deploy-bot: rollout update: canary=8% -> 20% after 12m health checks passed. id=cfg-throttle-2026-03-21
lee: sanity commands:
- status: `deployctl status cfg-throttle-2026-03-21`
- pause ramp: `deployctl pause cfg-throttle-2026-03-21`
- rollback: `deployctl rollback cfg-throttle-2026-03-21 --to=previous`
tara: If I need to roll back I'll run the rollback command and open a short incident note with the TL;DR and impact buckets.
alex: Heads-up to growth/product: this is a config-only change to throttles and timeouts, no model or behavior changes expected. Will post release notes after the window.
ops-bot: Rollout complete: reached 40% stable. id=cfg-throttle-2026-03-21. Observability: 95p latency change = +0.05s vs baseline; error-rate delta = +2%.
alex: Great, thanks team. Scheduling full rollout to 100% during low-traffic window tomorrow morning unless we see late regressions.
